proposals.statement:
theorem leftDiagonal_white_succ_iff (m i : ℕ) (hw : leftDiagonal (m + 2) i = false) :
    leftDiagonal (m + 2) (i + 1) = false ↔
      leftDiagonal m (i + 2) = leftDiagonal (m + 1) (i + 1) := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: The onset of a diagonal is the onset of the one beneath plus the white run it shows at that moment, and this is what one cell of a white run costs: the two diagonals beneath must agree.
proposals.disclaims: Bounds no white run; it says what a white run is made of.

route.tactics:
rw [leftDiagonal_recurrence, hw]
  cases leftDiagonal m (i + 2) <;> cases leftDiagonal (m + 1) (i + 1) <;> decide

witness.expression: (List.range 6).all fun i => leftDiagonal (m + 2) i || (decide (leftDiagonal (m + 2) (i + 1) = false) == decide (leftDiagonal m (i + 2) = leftDiagonal (m + 1) (i + 1)))

proposals.statement:
theorem leftDiagonal_agree_succ_iff (m i : ℕ)
    (h : leftDiagonal (m + 2) (i + 2) = leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 1)) :
    leftDiagonal (m + 2) (i + 3) = leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 2) ↔
      (leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 1) = true ∧
          leftDiagonal m (i + 4) = leftDiagonal (m + 1) (i + 3)) ∨
      (leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 1) = false ∧ leftDiagonal m (i + 4) = false) := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: A white run of length w on one diagonal is an agreement run beneath it, and this lemma is why that agreement reaches 2w diagonals shallower: any amortised bound on the onset has to walk this cascade.
proposals.disclaims: Says nothing about how often the cascade's conditions hold, which is the wall.

route.tactics:
have r1 := leftDiagonal_recurrence m (i + 2)
  have r2 := leftDiagonal_recurrence (m + 1) (i + 1)
  rw [show m + 1 + 2 = m + 3 by omega, show i + 1 + 1 = i + 2 by omega] at r2
  rw [show i + 2 + 1 = i + 3 by omega, show i + 2 + 2 = i + 4 by omega] at r1
  rw [r1, r2, ← h]
  generalize leftDiagonal (m + 2) (i + 2) = a at h ⊢
  cases a <;> cases leftDiagonal m (i + 4) <;> cases leftDiagonal (m + 1) (i + 3) <;> decide

witness.expression: (List.range 5).all fun i => (leftDiagonal (m + 2) (i + 2) != leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 1)) || (decide (leftDiagonal (m + 2) (i + 3) = leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 2)) == ((leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 1) && decide (leftDiagonal m (i + 4) = leftDiagonal (m + 1) (i + 3))) || (!leftDiagonal (m + 3) (i + 1) && !leftDiagonal m (i + 4))))
